themes.title: Bitcoin steadies as stocks slide
themes.summary: Bitcoin held near $64,600–$64,800 while the Nasdaq fell about 2%; CryptoTicker calculates a 0.67 correlation between daily Bitcoin and Nasdaq returns over 30 trading days (CryptoTicker).

themes.title: Sentiment stuck at extreme fear
themes.summary: The Fear & Greed Index read 10 on Monday, unchanged from Sunday and in the extreme-fear zone (alternative.me via CryptoTicker; KuCoin).

themes.title: ETF outflow streak
themes.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs logged seven straight sessions of net outflows, about $1.91 billion, through Nov. 13, and November outflows total about $2.1 billion (KuCoin; Cryptonews).

themes.title: Crypto stocks hit hard
themes.summary: Coinbase was down about 6.3% and Strategy about 7.4% Monday morning, more than Bitcoin itself (Yahoo Finance via CryptoTicker).

themes.title: Liquidity and rates weigh
themes.summary: Stablecoin supply fell about $17 billion over the past month (Glassnode), and markets expect another Fed hike in December with the 10-year yield near 5.15% (KuCoin).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Both slightly higher over 24 hours by late morning Monday, with Ether (+1.3%) ahead of Bitcoin (+0.5%) (The Daily Coins).

categories.name: Large-cap altcoins
categories.note: Mixed: Solana was flat at $71.00 and XRP up 0.4% to $0.9567 (CoinGecko via CryptoTicker), while Pepe fell 6.21% (The Daily Coins).

categories.name: DeFi
categories.note: Kava fell nearly 40% in a day after about 55.2 million tokens were abnormally borrowed and sold through Kava Lend; Aerodrome Finance fell 6.21% (KuCoin; The Daily Coins).

categories.name: Derivatives and ETFs
categories.note: Rolling 24-hour liquidations briefly topped $2 billion during the Nov. 15 selloff, mostly long positions (CoinGlass via KuCoin), and ETF outflows continued (Cryptonews).

watch_list.why: Analysts cite $62,000–$63,000 as a near-term support zone and $67,000–$70,000 as resistance; daily RSI near 24 is in oversold territory (KuCoin; Cryptonews).
With Bitcoin closely tracking the Nasdaq, Nvidia's report after the close on Nov. 17 is a key event for risk assets (CryptoTicker).
Fed minutes are due Wednesday and Anthropic's Nasdaq debut is expected Thursday, Nov. 19; ETF flows and stablecoin supply are also in focus (KuCoin; Yahoo Finance).
